summary: Plan for the robot's actual geometry and motion constraints rather than a point moving through a picture.
outcomes: Distinguish collision-free paths from executable trajectories
sequence: Map a robot configuration to occupied geometry
Inflate obstacles for a simple footprint
Check continuous edges and joint limits
Add timing under velocity and acceleration limits

visual.question: Why does a clear endpoint not imply a collision-free motion?
visual.interaction: Drag configurations and inspect swept paths between them

practice.task: Plan a simple arm or mobile-robot route
practice.success: All path segments and a time-parameterized trajectory satisfy declared geometric and motion bounds
